summary: Learn Primavera P6 and MS Project scheduling with hands-on baselines, updates, logic checks, and reporting for project controls teams.
lede: Project scheduling with Primavera P6 and MS Project covers building and controlling logic-linked schedules. For professionals who prepare, update, review, or report schedule data, it develops practical skills in setting up calendars, work breakdown structures, and activity relationships, then creating baselines and loading resources. Learners also practice recording progress, analyzing critical paths and variance, and communicating schedule status through reports, with Power BI reporting concepts introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with project schedules and need stronger control of Primavera P6 and MS Project outputs. It fits people who prepare, update, review, or report on schedule data in project delivery environments where baselines, logic links, and progress reporting matter.
modules: Project Scheduling Foundations in Primavera P6 and MS Project
Scheduling Logic and Critical Path Method
prerequisites: You will need a laptop with access to Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project or the versions specified by the provider. A working understanding of scheduling terminology and routine project controls documents is expected, and you should be ready to complete hands-on schedule-building exercises during the course.
